title: Two ratiometric fluorescent sensors originating from functionalized R6G@UiO-66s for selective determination of formaldehyde and amine compounds
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,14532-14544
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01251A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Wanqiao Bai, Zhuojun Zhao, Ting Zhang, Hongmei Chai, Loujun Gao
Two ratiometric fluorescence sensing systems based R6G@UiO-66-(a) and R6G@UiO-66-(b) were designed to detect formaldehyde and ethylenediamine with selective and reliable result.
